title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Mason Kortz is a clinical instructor at the Harvard Law School Cyberlaw Clinic, where he has worked since January 2017. There, he draws on both his legal training and his background as a software and database developer to bring a technical perspective to issues such as civil rights, government transparency, and police oversight.
